description: Search the web across engines (CN/EN/Code). Supports multi-query ('queries'), timeRange, site filter. Pass fetchTop (1~3) to auto-fetch top full articles as research brief in one turn. No API keys required.

engines.description: Search engines to use (default: auto-routes by query language; explicit engines do not cascade unless minResults is specified)

items.description: Search engine name. Valid values (normalize alias to canonical name): baidu, bing, bing-news, csdn, duckduckgo, exa, brave, juejin, startpage, yahoo, sogou, github, stackoverflow, hackernews, arxiv, code

fetchTop.description: Pass 1~3 to auto-fetch top full articles as a research brief in one shot, avoiding extra fetch turns

format.description: Output format: 'json' (default when fetchTop is 0) or 'markdown' (default when fetchTop > 0 for a structured research brief)

limit.description: Target total results after merging all engines (default: server DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT, usually 10). Not a per-engine quota: once enough results are collected, slower engines may be cancelled (see cancelledEngines). Pass explicit `engines` to disable early cancellation.

minResults.description: Auto-run additional engines when fewer usable results come back (default: 5 when engines omitted, 0 when engines explicitly specified)

queries.description: 1-4 queries run concurrently and merged (required if 'query' is omitted)

query.description: Single search query (required if 'queries' is omitted; use 'queries' for multi-intent fan-out)

searchMode.description: Execution mode: 'request' (HTTP only), 'auto' (HTTP with browser fallback), or 'playwright' (headless browser only)

site.description: Restrict search to specific site domain(s) (e.g. ['github.com', 'developer.mozilla.org'])

verbose.description: Include verbose diagnostic fields (engineMetrics, full failure hints, and redundant source hostnames); default false to save tokens

name: search
